.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1920px; margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular', sans-serif;}
.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1920px; margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular';}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._look ._pick_tit {left:0; width:100%; font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:60px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:80px; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}
._look ._soft {font-family:'Cormorant', serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap; color:#3E4F5B; opacity:0.5;}

._look ._tag ._pill {display:flex; align-items:center; height:41px; padding:10.8px 18px; border-radius:54px; font-size:16.2px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.49px; line-height:19px; white-space:nowrap; color:#fff;}
._look ._tag ._name {width:100%; margin-top:15.3px; font-size:20.7px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.62px; line-height:1.2; text-align:center; color:#000;}
._best ._best_tit {font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:60px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.8px; line-height:80px; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}
._best ._cate_tit {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; height:48px; font-size:40px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:48px; color:#161616;}
._best ._prd_list ._item ._thumb {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:231px; height:231px; background-color:#E5E5E5; overflow:hidden;}

._best ._prd_list ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; margin-top:10px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:18px;}

._exclusive ._gift_list ._only {position:absolute; left:15px; top:15px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:76px; height:76px; border-radius:900px; background-color:#DD153E; font-family:Avenir, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.16px; line-height:18px; text-align:center; color:#fff; z-index:1;}

._exclusive ._more {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:431px; min-height:50px; margin:62px auto 0; padding:0 30px; background-color:#05446D; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; line-height:21px; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
._look_sec ._tag {position:absolute; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:15.3px; width:240px; color:#fff;}

._look_sec ._label {display:flex; align-items:center; height:41px; padding:0 18px; border-radius:54px; background:#3e4f5b; font-size:16.2px; font-weight:600; line-height:19px; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#fff;}
._api_prd_sec ._cate_title ._txt {margin:0 10.5px 0 9.5px; font-size:40px; font-weight:700; line-height:48px; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#161616; white-space:nowrap;}
._api_prd_sec ._item ._thumb {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:231px; height:231px; background:#e5e5e5; overflow:hidden;}
._api_prd_sec ._item ._brand {display:block; margin-top:29px; font-size:16px; font-weight:800; line-height:19px; color:#000; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;}

._api_prd_sec ._item ._product {display:-webkit-box; margin-top:10px; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:18px; color:#000; word-break:break-word;}

._api_prd_sec ._slide_btn {position:absolute; top:50%; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:40px; height:40px; margin-top:-20px; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity 0.3s ease;}
._gift_sec ._gift_list ._thumb {position:relative; display:block; width:231px; height:231px; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; overflow:hidden;}

._gift_sec ._gift_list ._badge {position:absolute; left:15px; top:15px; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:76px; height:76px; padding:0 5px; box-sizing:border-box; border-radius:50%; background:#dd153e; overflow-wrap:anywhere; font-size:16px; font-weight:800; line-height:18px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#fff;}

._gift_sec ._more_bar ._txt {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; min-width:431px; height:50px; padding:0 30px; box-sizing:border-box; background:#05446d; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; line-height:21px;}
